# 1 Clement Chapter 56 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 56 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_056_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 56

**56:1** Let us also pray for those who have stumbled into sin — that God would grant them meekness and humility, so they would yield not to us but to God's will. That way, their remembrance before God and the saints will be fruitful, whole, and full of compassion.

**56:2** And let us accept correction ourselves — no one should resent it, dear friends. The way we admonish one another is genuinely good and tremendously helpful. It brings us into alignment with God's will.

**56:3** For the holy Scriptures say: "The LORD has punished me severely, yet he has not handed me over to death.

**56:4** For the LORD disciplines those he loves, and he chastises every child he embraces as his own."

**56:5** "A righteous person will correct me in kindness and will rebuke me — but let the oil of a wicked person never touch my head."

**56:6** And again: "Blessed is the person the LORD reproves — do not reject the correction of the Almighty. For he brings pain, and then he heals;

**56:7** he wounds, and his own hands restore.

**56:8** He will rescue you from trouble six times over; and the seventh time, no harm will come near you.

**56:9** In famine, he will save you from death; in battle, he will rescue you from the sword.

**56:10** He will shelter you from slanderous tongues, and you will have nothing to fear when disaster approaches.

**56:11** You will laugh at the unjust and the wicked; you will have no fear of wild animals.

**56:12** For wild animals will live in peace with you.

**56:13** You will know your home is at peace, and your dwelling place will be secure.

**56:14** You will know that your children will be many, and your descendants will flourish like grass in a field.

**56:15** You will go to your grave like ripe grain harvested in its season — or like a pile of grain gathered at the threshing floor at just the right time."

**56:16** You see, dear friends, what great protection comes to those who accept the Master's discipline. Like a good father, he corrects us so that we can receive his mercy through his holy discipline.

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the spirit of Clement's pastoral appeal.*
